newsitem.title: KUWAIT: National Bank of Kuwait H1 net up.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of Kuwait H1 net up.

text.p: National Bank of Kuwait (NBK), the country's largest commercial bank, on Tuesday reported a net profit for first half 1997 of 39.2 million dinars ($129.5 million).
Chairman Mohammad al-Bahar said this compared with 35.3 million dinars during the same period in 1996 and exceeded earlier estimates.
The statement gave no other figures but put shareholder's equity at 355 million dinars.
NBK shares closed on Tuesday on the Kuwait Stock Exchange at 600 fils (0.6 dinar).
In 1996 NBK net profit rose nine percent to 71.3 million dinars. The bank was founded in 1952 and has branches and subsidiaries in New York, London, Hanoi, Singapore, Paris and Bahrain.
